MediaFlow-v0.7.0-ffmpeg-source-compliance.zip is the matched separate release asset.
It contains the actual FFmpeg source archive, signature/key, exact configuration,
MediaFlow build recipe, MinGW-w64 full source archive and copyright/license records.
Restore the recipe into v0.7.0/poc/windows-ffmpeg in a checkout before building.
Build inputs and versions: ffmpeg-build-recipe.md in the source companion.
LLVM compiler-rt source:
https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/tree/85ac560262434c9ccfc0c183ec22d4138ed647fb/compiler-rt
MinGW-w64 source:
https://github.com/mingw-w64/mingw-w64/tree/57b595039040eaa15bece85b7cc71d952281b269

Public binary distribution MUST provide this matched source companion on the
same release page/channel, not merely refer to an upstream moving branch.
The v0.7.0 release page is planned at:
https://github.com/zzz468/MediaFlow-Dev/releases/tag/v0.7.0
Local RC preparation does not mean that publication has taken place.

After stopping MediaFlow, users can replace processing/ffmpeg with a compatible
FFmpeg shared-runtime set, keeping the original executable/DLL names and ABI.
MediaFlow does not enforce a binary hash or signature lock at runtime.
Build-time manifest verification does not restrict installed component replacement.
